errors.text_span: Скалата е линейна и етикетите са разположени на интервали от 5 години.
errors.evidence: The x-axis is categorical, representing distinct age groups ('19-25', '26-34', '35-44', '45+'), not a linear scale with 5-year intervals.

errors.text_span: Кривата започва около 48% и се покачва до 64%, след което намалява до 28%.
errors.evidence: The description of the light blue line ('Силно съгласен') is completely incorrect. The line actually starts at 28%, peaks at 48%, and then decreases to 44% and finally 36%.

errors.text_span: То започва около 36%, намалява до 26% и след това се покачва до 4% в края на графиката.
errors.evidence: The description of the orange line ('По-скоро съгласен') is completely incorrect. The line starts at 13%, rises to 26% (where it stays for one interval), and then sharply increases to 64%.

errors.text_span: Кривата започва около 20%, след това намалява до 12%
errors.evidence: The description of the grey line ('Не мога да преценя') uses incorrect values. The line starts at 25% and decreases to 4% and then 2%. The values 20% and 12% belong to other lines.

errors.text_span: Кривата започва на 16%, намалява до 4% и се запазва на 2% в края на графиката.
errors.evidence: The description of the yellow line ('По-скоро несъгласен') uses incorrect values. The line starts at 22%, decreases to 20%, then 16%, and ends at 0%. The values 4% and 2% belong to other lines.

errors.text_span: Синьото криволинейно представя отговорите на групата "5 Нищо несъгласен".
errors.evidence: The description uses 'Синьото' (Blue) for two different lines (the light blue and the dark blue) without differentiating them, causing confusion.
The category name is incorrect. The legend in the chart clearly states '5 Силно несъгласен' (Strongly disagree), not 'Нищо несъгласен' (Nothing disagree).

errors.text_span: Кривата обикаля около 2% и се стабилизира на 0% в края на графиката.
errors.evidence: This description of the dark blue line is incorrect and an over-generalization. The line does not 'hover around 2%'; it starts low, increases to 4% and then to a peak of 12%, before dropping to 0%.

errors.text_span: диапазонът на стойностите варира от 0% до 64%
errors.evidence: This describes the range of the data points, not the range of the Y-axis itself, which appears to go up to 80% based on the gridlines.
While the description correctly identifies the 10% intervals for the y-axis gridlines ('нивата'), it fails to mention that the axis has no explicit numerical labels.
